simple.meaning: חָרַת (chârath) is a Hebrew action word meaning “to engrave.” BibleIQ anchors the English reading to this source verb before comparing its uses.
simple.biblicalBackground: This action appears 1 time in Exodus, beginning at Exodus 32:16. Its meaning becomes clearer as the uses are compared.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to חָרַת (H2801) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: Actions in Scripture show what people do, what God does, and how covenant faithfulness or rebellion is described. BibleIQ compares the action across its occurrences.
simple.summary: חָרַת (chârath) / H2801 is traced through Exodus 32:16 with source-language evidence and verse context.
